svg.title: 60-naive-5ms-diagram-slow-frames-every-1s-out-of-order
svg.text: The whole run: 8.0 s, 439 presented frames on a 60 Hz display, measured against a 16.7 ms target.
More about this run in the notes at the end of the card.
16.7 ms per refresh, target 1 refresh (60 fps)
ANIMATION ERROR PER FRAME: + SHOWN TOO SOON, − SHOWN TOO LATE
■ within the error threshold ■ delta time jitter: off by less than the intended period ┅ a whole refresh early or late
DISPLAY TIME STEP: HOW LONG EACH FRAME STAYED ON SCREEN
━ as planned ━ held: the next frame was late ━ held: an older frame came back ┅ target
FRAMETIME AND CPU BUSY: THE APPLICATION SIDE, FROM THE MARKERS
━ frametime: CPU start to the next ■ CPU busy: until presented ┅ target
SHARE OF LATE FRAMES IN THE LAST 2 S (WHOLE RUN 6.4 %)
━ none late ━ on screen longer than the application prefers, not late ━ late: longer than animated for and than intended
REFRESH STRIP: ONE CELL PER REFRESH, A NEW SHADE PER FRAME
■ late ■ delta time jitter ■ an older frame (out of order)
EVENTS: WHAT THE FRAMES DID, WHAT THE CAPTURE MISSED
frames: ■ 25 out of order capture: nothing missed
Resolution 16.7 ms (one capture period); error threshold 1 ms.
